signIn.choose: Which business do you want to sign in to?
signIn.subtitle: Welcome back. Sign in to your business.
signIn.waitMinutes_one: Too many tries. Please wait about {{count}} minute.
signIn.waitMinutes_other: Too many tries. Please wait about {{count}} minutes.

register.haveAccount: I already have a business: sign in
register.sent: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to finish creating your business.
register.phoneNote: Phone numbers will be read with the calling code +{{code}}.
register.devOnly: Development only: no email is sent here.

home.title: Today
home.subtitle: Here is where your business stands.

notFound: This page does not exist, or you do not have access to it.

auth.tagline: Run every branch of your business from one place.
auth.subtitle: Sales, stock, purchasing, books and payroll, together and always in step.

offline: You are offline. Changes will not save until you reconnect.

unreachable.title: Cannot reach Ziira
unreachable.hint: Check your connection. Your session is safe; try again in a moment.

notFoundHint: The page may have moved, or your role may not include it.

mfa.codeHint: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code it shows for Ziira.
mfa.expiresNote: This step stays open for 5 minutes. After that, you will need to enter your password again.
mfa.expired: Your sign-in timed out. Please enter your password again.
mfa.backupHint: Enter one of the backup codes you saved when you set up two-step verification. Each code works only once.
mfa.backupFormat: A backup code looks like abcde-fghjk.
mfa.wrongCode: That code is not right. Check the code in your app and try again.
mfa.wrongBackup: That backup code is not right, or it was already used.
mfa.setupRequiredHint: Your business requires two-step verification for your account. Set it up now to continue.
mfa.setupRequiredWhy: You can use Ziira as soon as this is done. It takes about two minutes and you need an authenticator app on your phone.
mfa.step1: 1. Add Ziira to your authenticator app
mfa.scanHint: Scan this picture with an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Authy.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code to scan with your authenticator app
mfa.orType: Cannot scan? Type this key into the app instead:
mfa.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
mfa.step2: 2. Enter the code the app shows
mfa.backupWhy: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. They are shown only now, so keep them somewhere safe.
mfa.backupOnce: You will not be able to see these codes again. Anyone who has them can use them to sign in as you.
mfa.fileHeader: Ziira backup codes. Each code works once.
mfa.saved: I have saved my backup codes

card.title: Two-step verification
card.hint: Asks for a code from your phone, as well as your password, each time you sign in.
card.lowBackup: You are running low on backup codes. Get new ones.
card.requiredNote: Your business requires two-step verification for you, so it cannot be switched off.
card.policyNote: Your business does not require it, but it is a good idea.
card.offHint: Enter your password and a current code (from your app, or a backup code) to confirm it is you.
card.newCodesHint: Your old backup codes will stop working. Enter your password and a current code to continue.
card.code: Code from your app, or a backup code
card.badCode: Enter the 6-digit code from your app, or a backup code like abcde-fghjk.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.hint: Enter the email or phone you sign in with. If it has an email address on file, we will send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.devOnly: Development only: no email is sent here.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.hint: Pick a password you do not use anywhere else.
reset.ruleCommon: Not an easy one to guess, such as "password123".
reset.ruleLogin: Not the same as your email or phone.
reset.done: Your password has been changed and you were signed out everywhere. Sign in with the new password.
